name: magnetic-tilt-button
title: Magnetic Tilt Button
description: A primary button that leans toward the mouse with tactile spring pull and specular light sheen reflection.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Proximity Tether Pull: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
